description: This file defines the KpiSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class. It specifies parameters for filtering KPI searches related to performance in the HRM system, including allowed sorting fields and a job title ID filter.

classes.name: KpiSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to encapsulate search filter parameters for KPI searches within the performance module of the HRM system. It includes attributes such as job title ID and predefined allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of KpiSearchFilterParams and sets the default sort field to 'kpi.title'.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Returns the current job title ID filter value.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter value.
